youtube.title: What happens when your heart stops? 💔
youtube.description:
Seconds, minutes, and the one thing that keeps you alive: someone who pushes hard and fast.
Could you do CPR? Comment A or B 👇

Cardiac arrest: call your emergency number (112 in Europe, 911 in the US), push hard and fast in the center of the chest, use an AED if there is one. Learn CPR in a local first-aid course.

Sources: American Heart Association · The Conversation (why flatlines aren't shocked) · ProTrainings
